headline: OpenAI ethics chief exits after less than one year tenure
body: OpenAI's head of ethics, Chloé Bakalar, departed the organization less than a year after joining, signaling continued internal friction around governance and safety frameworks. This departure matters for healthcare AI because clinical deployments require robust ethics oversight for patient data handling, algorithmic bias detection, and regulatory compliance. Healthcare organizations evaluating OpenAI's tools for EHR integration or clinical decision support need clarity on who owns safety accountability, especially as the vendor pursues Series B funding and prepares for potential IPO. The revolving door on ethics leadership suggests OpenAI may struggle to implement the governance structures that healthcare systems and regulators increasingly demand before integrating generative AI into patient-facing workflows.
